name: Japan & Korea
intro: 10 nights, 5 cities, two countries: from the neon of Tokyo to the hot springs of Hakone, the temples of Kyoto, the theme parks of Osaka, and on to Seoul.

Tokyo.blurb: Japan's capital runs on contrasts: Shibuya's crossing and backstreet kitchens, the elevated expressway loop at night, and the waterfront theatre of DisneySea. Three nights is enough for a good first taste.

Hakone.blurb: A mountain town of hot springs, cedar slopes and lake views within easy reach of Tokyo. One night is the classic ryokan pause: bathe, eat well, sleep early.

Kyoto.blurb: Eleven centuries of capital life, from the vermilion tunnels of Fushimi Inari to digital art rooms and Nara's famously fast mochi pounders.

Osaka.blurb: Japan's kitchen city, loud and friendly, here given over to a single full day at Universal Studios Japan with the park gates a short walk from the room.

Seoul.blurb: A capital that moves fast: Gangnam skincare clinics, the soaring shelves of Starfield Library, and the griddles and mung-bean pancakes of Gwangjang Market.
